freshness.note: Frozen historical input; not current league truth

baseline: Median traded position or pick cost per delivered win; age splits keep this yardstick
method: ridge least-squares with partial-pivot Gauss and sandwich covariance
howCounted: Valued two-sided trades in the selected seasons and league-year stretches. Prices are anchored to a next-draft first-round pick. At least 80 trades for the whole view, 60 per half or window, and 8 delivery records with at least 0.5 forecast wins. Delivered wins are compared with the forecast at trade time. Ranges carry price and delivery uncertainty. The going rate is the asset-count-weighted median across positions and picks, never a live quote.
